title: Good product
text: Good product. I love frothy cream in my coffee. I have 3 different kinds of frothers for various reasons. One has a single whisk and takes 3 aaa bats. It goes thru batteries very quickly, but I like the slower speed because it doesnt splash the coffee out of the cup. The second one has a double whisk frother that uses no batteries and charges with a usb cord but has no on and off switch.  It has 3 speed levels that you have to go thru to turn it off, thus creating a mess. The 3 rd one is this one. This one has the best of all three. It has the double whisk, goes by 2 aa batteries and when you are using it, as soon as you take your finger off the button, it stops so it doesnt need the on and off switch. It does have the tendency to splash out the coffee if you fill the cup too much. I now fill my cup up to 3/4 and no more. As soon as I see the coffee coming up i side the cup, I let go of the switch..thus giving me control. I also like that this has a stand thatnit slides in to keep on the counter. I do like this one the most.

product_metadata.title: Rechargeable Milk Frother Handheld with USB-C Cable, Electric Drink Mixer with S/S Whisk, 14000RPM Electric Whisk/Coffee Frother for Latte, Matcha, Protein Powder, Hot Chocolate (Black)
features: 【USB Rechargeable】The coffee frother is powered by a built-in 500mAh rechargeable battery. After being full of electricity, it can be used for a long time, without repeatedly replacing the battery, which is more environmentally friendly.

【Unique Design】The electric drink mixer comes with a comfortable handle and fashioned CD like button, which can be easily operated with one hand. The anti-roll design behind it makes the milk-foaming machine neater in the drawer, which is more space-saving than the frother with stand.

【Make Creamy Froth In Seconds】The compact and portable hand mixer has 14000RPM high speed motor inside, which delivers rich milk froth to your coffee or other beverages. You can make your favorite latte, cappuccino, macchiato, hot cocoa or matcha anytime you want.

【High Quality 】The liquid touch parts are made of food-safe 304 stainless steel. The portable electric whisk with an ergonomically handle fit comfortably in your hand, so you can stir with confidence and enjoy every cup of coffee with peace of mind.

【Easy to Clean】The electric matcha whisk is easy to clean without disassembling. You can directly place the stirring head into the water, and turn it on, the vortex flow will make the cleaning easier and more thorough, then dry by pushing the button again for 2-3 seconds.
